 }catch(error){if(error.handled)throw error;if(!authCurrent(epoch))throw authChanged();if(error.name==='AbortError')throw Object.assign(Error('读取超时，请重试。'),{code:'READ_TIMEOUT'});if(error instanceof TypeError)throw Error('网络连接失败，请检查连接后重试。');throw error;}finally{if(timer)clearTimeout(timer);if(authWrite&&!authCurrent(epoch))reconcileAuth();}\r
}\r
async function authBootstrap(){\r

 const pending=(async()=>{try{const d=await api('auth/status');if(!active())return false;if(!d||typeof d.setupRequired!=='boolean'||!Object.hasOwn(d,'user')||d.user!==null&&(!d.user||typeof d.user.id!=='string'||!d.user.id.trim()||typeof d.user.role!=='string'))throw Error('账号状态响应异常，请重新连接。');state.user=d.user;state.commissionPermission=d.commissionPermission||null;if(state.user&&['admin','operator','reviewer'].includes(state.user.role))shell();else auth(d.setupRequired,state.user?'当前账号没有后台管理权限。':'');return true;}catch(error){if(!active()||error.code==='AUTH_CHANGED')return false;if(error.status===401)requireLogin();else authConnectionError(error.message);return false;}finally{if(active())authStatusPending=null;}})();authStatusPending=pending;return pending;\r
}\r

 (admin?'<form id="ca-profile-form" class="grid-form ca-readonly" data-user-id="'+esc(p.userId)+'"><label class="wide">关联老师资料<select name="teacherId"><option value="">开通时自动建立老师资料</option>'+teachers.map(t=>'<option value="'+esc(t.id)+'"'+(t.id===p.teacherId?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(t.name||t.id)+(t._status==='published'?'':' · 未发布')+'</option>').join('')+(p.teacherId&&!teachers.some(t=>t.id===p.teacherId)?'<option selected value="'+esc(p.teacherId)+'">'+esc(p.teacherId)+'</option>':'')+'</select><span class="field-note">请核实申请人与老师身份一致。已有老师资料只能关联所属账号。</span></label><label class="wide">处理说明<textarea name="reason" rows="3" maxlength="500" minlength="2" required placeholder="记录核验结果或需补充的资料，申请人可看到此说明。"></textarea></label><div class="actions wide"><button class="btn" name="decision" value="approved">'+(p.status==='approved'?'保存开通与关联':'审核通过并开通')+'</button><button class="btn secondary" name="decision" value="rejected">退回申请</button><button class="btn danger" name="decision" value="suspended">暂停创作者资格</button></div><p class="hint wide">暂停后，该账号无法继续创作，已有创作者内容停止公开展示。</p><p class="error wide" role="alert"></p></form>':'<p class="permission-note ca-readonly">你可以查看入驻资料。资格开通、暂停和老师资料关联由管理员处理。</p>');\r

 const items=caState.works,filters=[['manual_review','待人工复核'],['ai_review','AI审核中'],['published','已发布'],['rejected','未通过'],['all','全部作品']],visible=caState.filter==='all'?items:items.filter(w=>w.status===caState.filter);\r
 document.getElementById('main').innerHTML=heading('创作者内容审核','<button class="btn secondary" data-nav="creatorReviews">刷新</button>')+\r
 '<div class="ca-flow" aria-label="人工审核流程"><span>创作者提交作品</span><b>→</b><span>平台人工复核</span><b>→</b><span>通过后发布到APP</span></div>'+\r
 '<p class="hint">当前按人工审核处理，AI接入暂缓。先查看原始内容、素材和审核记录，再作出决定。每次审核对应一个作品版本；作品有更新时需重新读取。</p>'+\r
 '<div class="ca-filters" aria-label="审核状态">'+filters.map(([key,label])=>'<button data-ca-filter="'+key+'" aria-pressed="'+(caState.filter===key)+'">'+label+' <span>'+ (key==='all'?items.length:items.filter(w=>w.status===key).length)+'</span></button>').join('')+'</div>'+\r
 '<div class="editor-layout ca-review-grid"><div>'+ (visible.length?table(['作品／作者','状态','操作'],visible.map(w=>[esc(w.title)+'<br><span class="meta">'+esc(w.displayName||w.ownerId)+' · '+esc(caTypes[w.type]||w.type)+'</span>',caBadge(w.status)+'<br><small class="meta">v'+esc(w.version)+'</small>','<button class="btn secondary small" data-ca-review="'+esc(w.id)+'">审阅作品</button>'])):'<div class="empty ca-empty">'+(caState.filter==='manual_review'?'当前没有待人工复核的作品。':'该状态下暂无作品。')+'</div>')+'</div><section class="panel ca-detail" id="ca-detail"><h2>作品审阅</h2><p class="hint">从列表选择作品，查看完整内容和审核轨迹。</p></section></div>';\r
 enhanceAdminLists();\r
}\r
function caHistory(items){\r
 return items.length?'<ol class="ca-history">'+items.map(r=>'<li><div class="ca-statusline"><b>'+esc({ai:'AI审核',human:'人工复核',appeal:'创作者申诉',submit:'提交审核',system:'系统处理'}[r.stage]||r.stage)+'</b><span class="badge">'+esc({approve:'通过',reject:'未通过',manual:'转人工',manual_review:'转人工',published:'通过',rejected:'未通过'}[r.decision]||r.decision)+'</span></div><p>'+esc(r.reason||'无补充说明')+'</p><small class="meta">'+caTime(r.created||r.createdAt)+(r.ruleVersion?' · 规则版本 '+esc(r.ruleVersion):'')+'</small></li>').join('')+'</ol>':'<p class="hint">暂无审核记录。</p>';\r
}\r
async function openCreatorReview(workId){\r
 const seq=state.seq,revision=++caState.detailRevision,detail=document.getElementById('ca-detail'),active=()=>revision===caState.detailRevision&&seq===state.seq&&state.nav==='creatorReviews'&&detail.isConnected&&document.getElementById('ca-detail')===detail;detail.innerHTML='<p class="ca-loading">正在读取作品与审核记录…</p>';\r
 try{\r
  const d=await api('admin/creator-reviews/'+encodeURIComponent(workId));if(!active())return;\r
  const w=d.item||caState.works.find(x=>x.id===workId);if(!w)throw Error('作品已不存在，请刷新列表。');caState.selected=w;\r
  const eligible=['manual_review','rejected','published'].includes(w.status),sections=Array.isArray(w.sections)?w.sections:[];\r
  detail.innerHTML='<div class="ca-statusline">'+caBadge(w.status)+'<span class="meta">'+esc(caTypes[w.type]||w.type)+' · 版本 '+esc(w.version)+'</span></div><h2 style="margin-top:12px">'+esc(w.title)+'</h2><p class="meta">'+esc(w.displayName||w.ownerId)+' · '+caTime(w.updatedAt)+'</p>'+\r
  caMedia(w.coverUrl,'image')+'<div class="ca-body">'+esc(w.body||'无正文')+'</div>'+caMedia(w.mediaUrl,w.format==='audio'?'audio':'video')+\r
  (sections.length?'<details><summary>课程章节（'+sections.length+'）</summary>'+sections.map((s,i)=>'<section class="ca-section"><b>'+esc(Array.isArray(s)?s[0]:(s.title||'章节 '+(i+1)))+'</b><p>'+esc(Array.isArray(s)?(s[2]||s[1]||''):(s.body||''))+'</p></section>').join('')+'</details>':'')+\r
  (w.reason?'<p class="ca-note">当前说明：'+esc(w.reason)+'</p>':'')+\r
  '<details open><summary>审核轨迹</summary>'+caHistory(d.reviews||d.items||[])+'</details>'+\r
  (eligible?'<form id="ca-review-form" class="grid-form ca-readonly" data-work-id="'+esc(w.id)+'" data-version="'+esc(w.version)+'"><label class="wide">人工复核说明<textarea name="reason" rows="3" maxlength="500" minlength="2" required placeholder="说明判断依据、具体片段和修改要求，创作者可看到此说明。"></textarea></label><div class="actions wide">'+(w.status==='published'?'':'<button class="btn" value="approve">审核通过并发布</button>')+'<button class="btn danger" value="reject">'+(w.status==='published'?'下架并说明原因':'退回修改')+'</button></div><p class="error ca-error wide" role="alert"></p></form>':'<p class="permission-note ca-readonly">'+(w.status==='draft'?'作品尚未提交审核，不能直接发布。':'AI审核正在处理中，完成后再进行人工复核。')+'</p>');\r
  detail.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});\r
 }catch(e){if(active())detail.innerHTML='<p class="error ca-error" role="alert">'+esc(e.message)+'</p><button class="btn secondary" data-ca-review="'+esc(workId)+'">重新读取</button>';}\r
}\r
function renderModerationSettings(){\r

}\r
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{\r
 const profile=e.target.closest('[data-ca-profile]');if(profile){renderCreatorProfile(profile.dataset.caProfile);return;}\r
 const filter=e.target.closest('[data-ca-filter]');if(filter){caState.filter=filter.dataset.caFilter;renderCreatorReviews();return;}\r
 const review=e.target.closest('[data-ca-review]');if(review)openCreatorReview(review.dataset.caReview);\r
});\r
document.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{\r
 const form=e.target;if(!['ca-profile-form','ca-review-form','ca-moderation-form'].includes(form.id))return;e.preventDefault();\r
 const values=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)),submitter=e.submitter,output=form.querySelector('.error'),buttons=[...form.querySelectorAll('button')],seq=state.seq;\r
 output.textContent='';buttons.forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);\r
 try{\r
  if(form.id==='ca-profile-form'){\r
   if(state.user.role!=='admin')throw Error('仅管理员可变更创作者资格。');\r
   if(!String(values.reason||'').trim())throw Error('请填写处理说明。');\r
   const status=submitter?.value;if(!['approved','rejected','suspended'].includes(status))throw Error('请选择处理方式。');\r
   await api('admin/creators/'+encodeURIComponent(form.dataset.userId),{status,teacherId:values.teacherId||'',reason:values.reason.trim()},'PATCH');\r
   if(seq===state.seq){toast('创作者状态已更新');await load('creators');}\r
  }else if(form.id==='ca-review-form'){\r
   if(!String(values.reason||'').trim())throw Error('请填写人工复核说明。');\r
   const decision=submitter?.value;if(!['approve','reject'].includes(decision))throw Error('请选择审核结果。');\r
   await api('admin/creator-reviews/'+encodeURIComponent(form.dataset.workId),{decision,reason:values.reason.trim(),version:Number(form.dataset.version)});\r
   if(seq===state.seq){toast(decision==='approve'?'审核通过，作品已发布':'作品已退回，创作者可查看原因');await load('creatorReviews');}\r
  }else{\r
   if(state.user.role!=='admin')throw Error('仅管理员可修改审核规则。');\r
   const enabled=values.enabled==='on',autoApprove=values.autoApprove==='on';\r
   if(enabled&&(!String(values.rules||'').trim()||!String(values.knowledge||'').trim()))throw Error('开启AI初审前，请填写审核规则和知识库。');\r
   await api('admin/moderation-settings',{enabled,autoApprove,rules:values.rules||'',knowledge:values.knowledge||''},'PUT');\r
   if(seq===state.seq){toast('审核规则与知识库已保存');await load('moderation');}\r
  }\r
 }catch(err){if(output.isConnected){output.textContent=err.message;if(form.id==='ca-review-form')output.textContent+=' 如作品已更新，请重新读取最新版本后再审核。';}}finally{buttons.forEach(b=>{if(b.isConnected)b.disabled=false;});}\r
});\r

// Company analytics: aggregated users only; no personal record or conversation export.\r
const anStyle=document.createElement('style');\r
anStyle.textContent='.an-controls{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.an-controls label{flex:1;min-width:140px;font-size:12px}.an-controls .actions{padding-bottom:1px}.an-presets{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.an-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin:18px 0}.an-summary span,.an-retention small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.an-summary strong{font-size:22px}.an-chart{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:300px;margin-top:16px}.an-chart text{font:12px Arial,sans-serif;fill:var(--muted)}.an-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px}.an-grid>section{min-width:0}.an-retention{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin:20px 0}.an-retention strong{display:block;font-size:26px}.an-detail{margin-top:16px}.an-window small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:9px}.an-state{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}@media(max-width:900px){.an-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:600px){.an-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.an-window strong{font-size:25px}.an-controls .actions{width:100%}.an-retention{gap:12px}.an-chart text{font-size:29px}}';\r
document.head.append(anStyle);\r
function anToday(){return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'Asia/Shanghai',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'}).format(new Date());}\r
function anShift(day,n){return new Date(Date.parse(day+'T00:00:00Z')+n*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);}\r
function anNumber(n){return n===null||n===undefined?'未采集':Number(n).toLocaleString('zh-CN',{maximumFractionDigits:2});}\r
function anCoverage(value){return ({uncollected:'未采集',partial:'部分覆盖／进行中',complete:'完整覆盖'})[value]||'';}\r
function anLocalTime(value){return value?new Date(value).toLocaleString('zh-CN',{hour12:false,timeZone:'Asia/Shanghai'}):'尚未开始';}\r
function anTable(headers,rows){return table(headers,rows).replace('class="table-wrap"','class="table-wrap" data-enhanced="true"');}\r
function anChart(rows){\r
 const values=rows.map(x=>x.activeUsers),valid=values.filter(x=>typeof x==='number');\r
 if(!valid.length)return '<div class="empty">所选区间尚未采集活跃数据</div>';\r
 const left=94,right=780,top=20,bottom=192,max=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(Math.max(...valid)/2)*2),x=i=>left+(rows.length===1?(right-left)/2:i/(rows.length-1)*(right-left)),y=v=>bottom-v/max*(bottom-top);\r
 let lines='',points=[];\r
 function flush(){if(!points.length)return;lines+='<polyline points="'+points.join(' ')+'" fill="none" stroke="#087e83" stroke-width="2.5"/>';points=[];}\r
 values.forEach((v,i)=>{if(typeof v==='number')points.push(x(i).toFixed(1)+','+y(v).toFixed(1));else flush();});flush();\r
 if(valid.length===1){const i=values.findIndex(v=>typeof v==='number');lines+='<circle cx="'+x(i)+'" cy="'+y(values[i])+'" r="4" fill="#087e83"/>';}\r
 const labels=[0,Math.floor((rows.length-1)/2),rows.length-1].filter((v,i,a)=>a.indexOf(v)===i);\r
 return '<svg class="an-chart" viewBox="0 0 820 230" role="img" aria-label="所选区间每个周期内去重的活跃用户趋势；未采集时段留空"><title>活跃用户趋势，单位：人</title>'+[0,.5,1].map(p=>'<line x1="'+left+'" y1="'+y(max*p)+'" x2="'+right+'" y2="'+y(max*p)+'" stroke="#d7e3e6" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/><text x="82" y="'+(y(max*p)+4)+'" text-anchor="end">'+new Intl.NumberFormat('zh-CN',{notation:'compact',maximumFractionDigits:1}).format(Math.round(max*p))+'</text>').join('')+lines+labels.map(i=>'<text x="'+x(i)+'" y="219" text-anchor="'+(i===0?'start':i===rows.length-1?'end':'middle')+'">'+esc(rows[i].date)+'</text>').join('')+'</svg>';\r
}\r
async function loadAnalyticsAdmin(seq){\r
 const end=anToday();state.analyticsFilters??={start:anShift(end,-29),end,grain:'day'};\r
 let data;try{data=await api('admin/analytics?'+new URLSearchParams(state.analyticsFilters));}catch(error){if(seq===state.seq)state.analytics=null;throw error;}\r
 if(seq!==state.seq||state.nav!=='analytics')return;\r
 state.analytics=data;renderAnalyticsAdmin();\r
}\r
function renderAnalyticsAdmin(){\r
 const d=state.analytics,f=state.analyticsFilters,today=anToday();\r
 const windows=[['day','今日活跃','DAU'],['week','本周活跃','WAU'],['month','本月活跃','MAU'],['year','本年活跃','YAU']];\r
 const featureRows=(d.features||[]).filter(x=>x.activeUsers>0||x.visits>0);\r
 document.getElementById('main').innerHTML=heading('数据中心','<div class="actions"><button class="btn secondary" data-nav="analytics">刷新</button><button class="btn" data-action="analytics-export">导出汇总 CSV</button></div>')+\r
 '<p class="hint">北京时间 · APP 内登录的普通用户与创作者 · 不含管理人员和未登录访问</p><div class="stats">'+windows.map(([key,label,short])=>{const w=d.windows[key];return '<div class="stat an-window"><span>'+label+' · '+short+'</span><strong>'+anNumber(w.activeUsers)+'</strong><small>'+esc(w.start)+' 至 '+esc(w.end)+'</small><small>'+anCoverage(w.coverage)+'</small></div>';}).join('')+'</div>'+\r
 '<p class="hint">以上四项按自然日、周一开始的自然周、自然月、自然年去重，截至当前。同一账号在一个周期内只计 1 人。</p>'+\r
 '<section class="panel"><h2>活跃趋势</h2><p class="hint">采集开始：'+esc(anLocalTime(d.collectedSince))+'。此前活跃数据标为“未采集”；今天仍在累计，未覆盖时段不补算。</p>'+\r
 '<form id="analytics-filter" class="an-controls"><label>开始日期<input type="date" name="start" value="'+esc(f.start)+'" max="'+today+'" required></label><label>结束日期<input type="date" name="end" value="'+esc(f.end)+'" max="'+today+'" required></label><label>汇总周期<select name="grain">'+[['day','按日'],['week','按周'],['month','按月'],['year','按年']].map(([k,v])=>'<option value="'+k+'" '+(f.grain===k?'selected':'')+'>'+v+'</option>').join('')+'</select></label><div class="actions"><button class="btn">查询</button></div></form>'+\r
 '<div class="an-presets">'+[7,30,90,365].map(n=>'<button class="btn secondary small" data-an-days="'+n+'">近 '+n+' 天</button>').join('')+'</div>'+\r
 '<p class="an-state">区间活跃覆盖：'+anCoverage(d.summary.coverage)+'</p><div class="an-summary">'+[['区间活跃用户',d.summary.activeUsers],['区间新增用户',d.summary.newUsers],['当前用户账号',d.summary.registeredUsers],['区间功能访问',d.summary.visits]].map(([label,value])=>'<div><span>'+label+'</span><strong>'+anNumber(value)+'</strong></div>').join('')+'</div>'+anChart(d.trend)+\r
 '<p class="hint">曲线为每个周期内去重的活跃人数，跨周期相加不等于区间活跃人数。功能访问按同账号、同功能 30 秒去重；续用心跳只计活跃，不增加访问。</p>'+\r

 \${s.busy?'<p role="status">正在处理…</p>':''}\${s.error?\`<p class="error" role="alert">\${esc(s.error)}</p>\`:''}\r
 \${s.items.length?table(['工单','问题','状态','订单','操作'],s.items.map(item=>[\r
  esc(item.id),payAdminTypes[item.kind],payAdminStatuses[item.status],esc(item.orderId||'未关联'),\r

 \${s.next?\`<button type="button" class="btn secondary" data-pay-admin="more" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>更早的工单</button>\`:''}\r
 \${ticket?\`<section class="panel"><h3>\${payAdminTypes[ticket.kind]} · \${payAdminStatuses[ticket.status]}</h3>\r

 \${s.detail.accountClosed?'<p class="hint">账号已关闭，工单正文已清理。</p>':''}\r
 </section>\`:''}\`;\r
}\r
async function payAdminLoad(s,more=false){\r
 const query=new URLSearchParams();\r
 if(s.filter)query.set('status',s.filter);\r
 if(more)query.set('before',s.next);\r
 const data=await api('admin/payment-support/tickets?'+query);\r
 if(!payAdminActive(s))return;\r
 s.loaded=true;s.items=more?s.items.concat(data.items.filter(item=>!s.items.some(old=>old.id===item.id))):data.items;s.next=data.next;\r
}\r
async function payAdminRun(s,work){\r
 if(s.busy||!payAdminActive(s))return;\r
 const reply=document.querySelector('#pay-admin-action textarea');\r
 if(reply)s.reply=reply.value;\r
 s.busy=true;s.error='';payAdminRender(s);\r
 try{await work();}\r
 catch(error){if(payAdminActive(s)&&!error.handled)s.error=error.message;}\r
 finally{s.busy=false;payAdminRender(s);}\r
}\r
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{\r
 const control=event.target.closest('[data-pay-admin]');if(!control)return;\r
 event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\r
 const s=payAdminState(),action=control.dataset.payAdmin;\r
 payAdminRun(s,async()=>{\r
  if(action==='view'){\r
   const detail=await api('admin/payment-support/tickets/'+encodeURIComponent(control.dataset.id));\r
   if(!payAdminActive(s))return;\r
   if(s.detail?.ticket.id!==detail.ticket.id)s.reply='';\r
   s.detail=detail;\r
  }else{\r
   if(action==='load'&&s.detail){\r
    s.detail=await api('admin/payment-support/tickets/'+encodeURIComponent(s.detail.ticket.id));\r
   }\r
   await payAdminLoad(s,action==='more');\r
  }\r
 });\r
},true);\r
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{\r
 if(event.target.id!=='pay-admin-filter')return;\r
 const s=payAdminState();s.filter=event.target.value;s.next=null;\r
 payAdminRun(s,()=>payAdminLoad(s));\r
});\r
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{\r
 if(event.target.id!=='pay-admin-action')return;\r
 event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();\r
 const s=payAdminState(),ticket=s.detail?.ticket;\r
 if(!ticket)return;\r
 const reply=new FormData(event.target).get('reply').trim();\r
 const body={version:ticket.version,status:ticket.status==='submitted'?'accepted':'resolved',reply};\r
 const signature=JSON.stringify([ticket.id,body]);\r
 if(s.signature!==signature){s.signature=signature;s.requestId=crypto.randomUUID();}\r
 payAdminRun(s,async()=>{\r
  const data=await api('admin/payment-support/tickets/'+encodeURIComponent(ticket.id)+'/actions',{...body,requestId:s.requestId});\r
  if(!payAdminActive(s))return;\r
  s.detail.ticket=data.ticket;s.reply='';s.signature='';\r
  await payAdminLoad(s);\r
 });\r
},true);\r

const opsThresholds={callbackBacklog:'回调积压',recoveryBacklog:'查单积压',lateRefundPending:'退款待办',lateRefundProcessing:'退款受理待办',privacyObjectPending:'文件待办'};\r
const opsStatuses={running:'运行中',succeeded:'本次处理已完成',skipped:'本次未领取任务',failed:'本次处理失败',unknown:'结果待核实',lease_lost:'租约或配置已变化',active:'当前活跃',stopped:'已停止',stale:'心跳已过期',auth_required:'需要有效管理员登录',open:'待受理',acknowledged:'已受理',resolved:'后续完整扫描已解除',pending:'待处理',processing:'处理中',retry:'待重试',fixture_confirmed:'本机接收夹具已确认',manual_review:'待人工核查',idle:'暂无到期任务'};\r
const opsRuleNames={callback_backlog:'回调积压',callback_manual_review:'回调待人工核查',recovery_backlog:'查单积压',recovery_error:'查单异常',late_refund_pending:'退款待办老化',late_refund_processing:'退款受理待办老化',privacy_object_pending:'文件任务积压',privacy_object_manual_review:'文件任务待核查',digital_finite_grant_missing:'数字作品缺少成交权益',digital_finite_grant_binding:'数字作品成交权益关联异常',membership_quota_period_binding:'会员已发周期关联异常',membership_quota_grant_fact:'会员周期发放事实异常',membership_quota_job_binding:'会员任务额度关联异常'};\r

const opsOriginalInvalidateAuth=invalidateAuth;\r

Object.assign(opsRuleNames,{digital_grant_missing:'数字作品缺少成交权益',digital_grant_binding_mismatch:'数字作品成交权益关联异常',membership_period_binding_mismatch:'会员已发周期关联异常',membership_grant_event_missing:'会员周期缺少发放事件',membership_grant_event_orphan:'会员发放事件缺少周期',membership_job_allocation_missing:'会员任务缺少额度分配',membership_job_allocation_binding_mismatch:'会员任务额度关联异常',membership_job_allocation_settlement_mismatch:'会员任务结算关联异常',recovery_query_error:'查单异常'});\r
const opsSourceNames={callbackInbox:'回调收件',paymentRecovery:'付款查单',lateCases:'迟到付款待办',privacyObjects:'已确认文件队列',reconciliation:'本方账目一致性',digitalFiniteGrants:'数字作品成交权益',membershipMaterializedQuota:'会员已物化周期',membershipBoundJobs:'会员额度任务关联'};\r
const opsReasonNames={threshold_unconfirmed:'老化阈值未确认',threshold_null:'老化阈值未确认',missing_table:'来源表缺失',source_missing:'来源缺失',truncated:'读取已截限',invalid_json:'来源格式不符合要求',not_applicable:'当前不适用',backend_no_r2:'此后端没有对象存储消费者'};\r
function opsSourceLabel(value){const code=String(value||'—'),label=opsSourceNames[code]||(code.startsWith('aging:')?(opsRuleNames[code.slice(6)]||code.slice(6))+'规则':code);return esc(label)+(label!==code?'<br><span class="hint">'+esc(code)+'</span>':'');}\r
const opsAdminStyles='<style>#local-tasks-admin{min-width:0}#local-tasks-admin .ops-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,240px),1fr));gap:14px}#local-tasks-admin fieldset{min-width:0;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--line,#cfc8b9);border-radius:10px;padding:12px}#local-tasks-admin .ops-wide{grid-column:1/-1}#local-tasks-admin .ops-reference,#local-tasks-admin pre{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap}#local-tasks-admin pre{font:inherit;line-height:1.7}#local-tasks-admin .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%}#local-tasks-admin table{min-width:900px;table-layout:fixed}#local-tasks-admin td,#local-tasks-admin th{overflow-wrap:anywhere;vertical-align:top}#local-tasks-admin th:first-child{width:250px}#local-tasks-admin .ops-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}#local-tasks-admin .ops-actions>*{max-width:100%}#local-tasks-admin .ops-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,220px),1fr));gap:10px}#local-tasks-admin details{margin:12px 0}#local-tasks-admin summary{cursor:pointer;line-height:1.7}#local-tasks-admin .ops-check{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}#local-tasks-admin .ops-check input{width:auto;flex:none;margin-top:5px}#local-tasks-admin textarea{min-height:100px}#local-tasks-admin .ops-disabled-group{border:0!important;padding:0!important}</style>';\r

function opsState(){if(!opsAdminSession||opsAdminSession.epoch!==state.authEpoch||opsAdminSession.seq!==state.seq)opsAdminSession={epoch:state.authEpoch,seq:state.seq,mount:crypto.randomUUID(),workerId:'browser-'+crypto.randomUUID(),runs:[],workers:[],alerts:[],filter:'',next:{},loaded:{},errors:{},open:new Set(),busy:false};return opsAdminSession;}\r
function opsActive(s){const node=document.getElementById('local-tasks-admin');return authCurrent(s.epoch)&&state.nav==='commerce'&&state.user?.role==='admin'&&state.seq===s.seq&&(!node||node.dataset.opsMount===s.mount);}\r
function opsField(name,label,type,value,extra=''){return \`<label>\${label}<input type="\${type}" name="\${name}" value="\${esc(value??'')}" \${extra}></label>\`;}\r
function opsDetailOpen(s,key){return s.open.has(key)?'open':'';}\r
function opsMeta(s,key,title,value){return \`<details data-ops-detail="\${esc(key)}" \${opsDetailOpen(s,key)}><summary>\${title}</summary><pre>\${esc(JSON.stringify(value??{},null,2))}</pre></details>\`;}\r
function opsAdminPanel(){const s=opsState();return \`<section class="panel" id="local-tasks-admin" data-ops-mount="\${s.mount}">\${opsMarkup(s)}</section>\`;}\r
function opsCoverage(s,c){\r
 if(!c?.scanId&&!c?.observedAt)return '<p class="hint">尚无成功记录的监测扫描，不能据此认定没有异常。</p>';\r
 const rows=Array.isArray(c.sources)?c.sources:Object.entries(c.sources||{}).map(([source,v])=>({source,...v}));\r
 return \`<section id="ops-coverage"><h3>监测覆盖</h3><p>观测时间：\${esc(opsDate(c.observedAt))} · \${c.partial?'部分本地来源未覆盖':'请按下列实际来源核对覆盖'}</p>\${rows.length?table(['来源','适用与覆盖','已读取 / 总数','截限','说明'],rows.map(r=>[opsSourceLabel(r.source||r.name),r.covered===true?'已覆盖':'未覆盖',\`\${r.loadedRows??'—'} / \${r.totalRows??'—'}\`,r.truncated?'是':'否',esc(opsReasonNames[r.reason||r.reasonCode]||r.reason||r.reasonCode||(r.applicable===false?'当前不适用':'—'))])):''}\r
 \${opsMeta(s,'coverage-rules','规则覆盖与未覆盖原因',c.ruleCoverage||c.rules||{})}\${opsMeta(s,'coverage-external','未覆盖项目与外部指标',{uncovered:c.uncovered||[],unsupportedMetrics:c.unsupportedMetrics||{}})}</section>\`;\r
}\r
function opsConfigForm(s){\r
 const d=s.draft;if(!d)return '';\r
 const stale=s.config&&d.revision!==s.config.revision;\r
 return \`<section><h3>运行规则</h3><p>编辑版本 \${Number(d.revision)}。期限留空表示该老化规则未确认；不会按零秒代入。</p>\${stale?'<p class="error">服务器配置已有新版本，当前输入仍保留。请载入当前配置后重新核对，不能覆盖新版本。</p>':''}<form id="ops-config-form" class="ops-form"><fieldset class="ops-wide ops-form ops-disabled-group" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>\r
 <label class="ops-check ops-wide"><input type="checkbox" name="enabled" \${d.enabled?'checked':''}>启用这个本地隔离运行时的任务领取</label>\${opsField('ruleVersion','规则版本','text',d.ruleVersion,'maxlength="80"')}\r
 \${Object.entries(opsKinds).map(([kind,label])=>{const t=d.tasks[kind],max=kind==='payment_recovery'?5:kind==='payment_monitor'?1:10,min=kind==='payment_monitor'?30:5;return \`<fieldset data-ops-task="\${kind}"><legend>\${label}</legend><label class="ops-check"><input type="checkbox" name="\${kind}_enabled" \${t.enabled?'checked':''}>启用此任务</label>\${opsField(kind+'_interval','间隔（秒）','number',t.intervalSeconds,\`required min="\${min}" max="3600" step="1"\`)}\${opsField(kind+'_limit','单批上限','number',t.batchLimit,\`required min="1" max="\${max}" step="1" \${max===1?'readonly':''}\`)}</fieldset>\`;}).join('')}\r
 <fieldset class="ops-wide"><legend>独立老化阈值（秒）</legend><div class="ops-form">\${Object.entries(opsThresholds).map(([key,label])=>opsField('age_'+key,label,'number',d.thresholdSeconds[key], 'min="0" max="31536000" step="1"')).join('')}</div></fieldset>\r
 <label class="ops-check ops-wide"><input type="checkbox" name="confirmed" required \${s.confirmSave?'checked':''}>确认按当前版本保存以上本地任务和监测规则</label><div class="ops-actions ops-wide"><button class="btn secondary" type="submit" \${s.busy||stale?'disabled':''}>保存规则</button><button class="btn secondary" type="button" data-ops="config-current" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>载入服务器当前配置（替换未保存输入）</button></div></fieldset></form></section>\`;\r
}\r
function opsRunDetail(s){\r
 const d=s.runDetail,r=d?.run;if(!r)return '';\r
 return \`<section class="panel" id="ops-run-detail"><h3>运行记录 · \${opsText(r.status)}</h3><p class="ops-reference">记录：\${esc(r.id)}<br>进程标识：\${esc(r.workerId)}<br>任务：\${esc(opsKinds[r.kind]||opsStatuses[r.kind]||r.kind)}<br>配置版本：\${Number(r.configRevision)}<br>开始：\${esc(opsDate(r.started))}<br>完成回执：\${esc(opsDate(r.finished))}<br>本次处理数量：\${Number(r.processed)}<br>核查代码：\${esc(r.lastError||'—')}</p>\r
 \${(d.items||[]).map((item,i)=>\`<p>\${esc(opsKinds[item.kind]||item.kind)} · \${item.applicable===false?'此后端不适用':opsStatuses[item.status]||item.status} · \${Number(item.processed)}<br>\${esc(item.errorCode||'')}</p>\${opsMeta(s,'run-sources-'+i,'来源记录与覆盖明细',{sourceIds:item.sourceIds||[],coverage:item.coverage||null})}\`).join('')}</section>\`;\r
}\r
function opsAlertDetail(s){\r
 const d=s.alertDetail,a=d?.item;if(!a)return '';\r
 const categories=[['actions','actionsNext','受理记录',['时间','操作','操作者','备注'],r=>[esc(opsDate(r.created)),opsText(r.action),esc(r.actor),esc(r.note||'')]],['notifications','notificationsNext','本机通知事件',['事件','状态','实际尝试次数','下次时间','操作'],r=>[esc(r.eventId),opsText(r.status),Number(r.attempts),esc(opsDate(r.nextAttempt)),['retry','manual_review'].includes(r.status)&&r.attempts<5?\`<button class="btn secondary small" type="button" data-ops="notification-retry" data-id="\${esc(r.id)}" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>原事件重新排队</button>\`:'—']],['attempts','attemptsNext','通知尝试',['时间','次数','动作 / 结果','代码'],r=>[esc(opsDate(r.created)),Number(r.attempt),opsText(r.action)+' / '+opsText(r.result),esc(r.errorCode||'—')]],['receipts','receiptsNext','本机确认回执',['事件','实际HTTP','次数','确认时间'],r=>[esc(r.eventId),Number(r.httpStatus),Number(r.attempt),esc(opsDate(r.confirmedAt))]]];\r
 return \`<section class="panel" id="ops-alert-detail"><h3>\${esc(opsRuleNames[a.ruleCode]||a.ruleCode)} · \${opsText(a.status)}</h3><p class="ops-reference">告警：\${esc(a.id)} · 第 \${Number(a.episode)} 次发生<br>来源：\${esc(a.sourceType)} / \${esc(a.sourceId)}<br>首次：\${esc(opsDate(a.firstSeen))}<br>最近：\${esc(opsDate(a.lastSeen))}<br>观测次数：\${Number(a.seenScanCount)}（不是付款失败次数）</p>\${opsMeta(s,'alert-summary','来源事实与规则版本',a.summary)}\r
 \${a.status==='open'?\`<form id="ops-ack-form"><fieldset \${s.busy?'disabled':''}><label>内部受理备注<textarea name="note" required maxlength="1000">\${esc(s.ackNote||'')}</textarea></label><p class="hint">受理只记录处置责任，不修改订单、退款、权益或原异常状态。</p><button class="btn secondary" type="submit" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>记录已受理</button></fieldset></form>\`:\`<p>受理人：\${esc(a.ackBy||'—')} · \${esc(opsDate(a.ackAt))}<br>解除时间：\${esc(opsDate(a.resolvedAt))}</p>\`}\r
 \${categories.map(([key,next,title,headers,row])=>\`<h4>\${title}</h4>\${d[key]?.length?table(headers,d[key].map(row)):'<p class="hint">暂无相应记录。</p>'}\${d[next]?\`<button class="btn secondary" type="button" data-ops="detail-more" data-category="\${key}" \${s.busy?'disabled':''}>更早的\${title}</button>\`:''}\`).join('')}\r
 <p class="hint">“本机接收夹具已确认”只表示本机HTTP接收核验，未向真实外部收件人发送。重新排队不重置尝试次数。</p></section>\`;\r
}\r
function opsMarkup(s){\r
 const r=s.runtime,disabled=s.busy?'disabled':'',ready=r?.identityReady===true&&r.envEnabled===true;\r
 return \`\${opsAdminStyles}<h2>持续任务与异常处置</h2><p class="hint">查看本地任务进程、监测覆盖、告警和处理回执。外部渠道、银行到账与真实收件方分别接入验收。</p><div class="ops-actions"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" data-ops="refresh" \${disabled}>\${s.loaded.runtime?'刷新运行与告警':'查看运行与告警'}</button><button type="button" class="btn secondary" data-ops="tick" \${disabled||!ready||!s.config?.enabled?'disabled':''}>\${s.pendingTick?'使用原编号重查并重试':'执行一次当前到期任务'}</button></div>\r
 \${s.busy?'<p role="status">正在处理，请稍候…</p>':''}\${s.error?\`<p class="error" role="alert">\${esc(s.error)}</p>\`:''}\${s.notice?\`<p role="status">\${esc(s.notice)}</p>\`:''}\${Object.entries(s.errors).map(([key,msg])=>\`<p class="error">\${esc(key)}读取未完成：\${esc(msg)}；已显示记录以各自读取时间为准。</p>\`).join('')}\r
 \${r?\`<div class="ops-facts"><p>运行身份：\${ready?'已核验本地隔离标识':'未就绪，不能领取任务'}<br>持续领取：\${s.config?.enabled?'已启用规则':'已关闭'}<br>本机通知夹具：\${r.notificationReady?'已配置':'未配置'}</p><p class="ops-reference">运行标识：\${esc(r.runtimeId||'未配置')}<br>APP构建SHA：\${esc(r.appSha256||'未核验')}</p></div><p class="hint">本页单次执行不会启动常驻进程。常驻进程须使用本机已核验的启动配置及当前管理员登录；失去权限后停止新领取。关闭配置不表示已开始的业务被取消。</p>\${opsConfigForm(s)}\`:''}\r
 \${opsCoverage(s,s.coverage)}<section id="ops-runs"><h3>持久运行记录</h3>\${s.runs.length?table(['任务 / 记录','状态','处理数量','开始时间','操作'],s.runs.map(x=>[esc(opsKinds[x.kind]||opsStatuses[x.kind]||x.kind)+'<br>'+esc(x.id),opsText(x.status),Number(x.processed),esc(opsDate(x.started)),\`<button class="btn secondary small" type="button" data-ops="run" data-id="\${esc(x.id)}" \${disabled}>查看</button>\`])):\`<p>\${s.loaded.runs?'暂无运行记录。':'尚未读取运行记录。'}</p>\`}\${s.next.runs?\`<button class="btn secondary" data-ops="runs-more" \${disabled}>更早的运行记录</button>\`:''}<p class="hint">处理数量不是付款、退款或文件核验成功数量，请核对原业务回执。</p></section>\${opsRunDetail(s)}\r
 <section id="ops-workers"><h3>进程心跳</h3>\${s.workers.length?table(['进程标识','状态','最后心跳','代码'],s.workers.map(x=>[esc(x.id),opsText(x.status),esc(opsDate(x.lastHeartbeat)),esc(x.lastError||'—')])):\`<p>\${s.loaded.workers?'暂无已登记进程。':'尚未读取进程。'}</p>\`}\${s.next.workers?\`<button class="btn secondary" data-ops="workers-more" \${disabled}>更早的进程</button>\`:''}</section>\r
 <section id="ops-alerts"><h3>异常与受理</h3><label>状态筛选<select id="ops-alert-filter" \${disabled}><option value="">全部状态</option>\${['open','acknowledged','resolved'].map(v=>\`<option value="\${v}" \${s.filter===v?'selected':''}>\${opsStatuses[v]}</option>\`).join('')}</select></label>\${s.alerts.length?table(['规则 / 来源','状态','最近观测','次数','操作'],s.alerts.map(x=>[esc(opsRuleNames[x.ruleCode]||x.ruleCode)+'<br>'+esc(x.sourceId),opsText(x.status),esc(opsDate(x.lastSeen)),Number(x.seenScanCount),\`<button class="btn secondary small" type="button" data-ops="alert" data-id="\${esc(x.id)}" \${disabled}>查看与受理</button>\`])):\`<p>\${s.loaded.alerts?'当前筛选下暂无已记录告警；仍须核对监测覆盖。':'尚未读取告警。'}</p>\`}\${s.next.alerts?\`<button class="btn secondary" data-ops="alerts-more" \${disabled}>更早的告警</button>\`:''}</section>\${opsAlertDetail(s)}\`;\r
}\r
function opsRender(s){if(!opsActive(s))return;const node=document.getElementById('local-tasks-admin');if(node)node.innerHTML=opsMarkup(s);}\r
async function opsRun(s,work){if(s.busy||!opsActive(s))return;s.busy=true;s.error='';s.notice='';opsRender(s);try{await work();}catch(e){if(opsActive(s)&&e.status===403){invalidateAuth(true);await authBootstrap();}else if(opsActive(s)&&!e.handled)s.error=e.message||'操作未确认，请回查原记录。';}finally{s.busy=false;opsRender(s);}}\r
function opsAlertQuery(s,more=false){const q=new URLSearchParams();if(s.filter)q.set('status',s.filter);if(more)q.set('before',s.next.alerts);return q.toString();}\r
async function opsLoad(s){\r
 const sequence=(s.readSeq||0)+1;s.readSeq=sequence;\r
 const keys=['runtime','runs','workers','alerts'],paths=['admin/local-tasks/runtime','admin/local-tasks/runs','admin/local-tasks/workers','admin/payment-alerts?'+opsAlertQuery(s)];\r
 const results=await Promise.allSettled(paths.map(p=>api(p)));if(!opsActive(s)||s.readSeq!==sequence)return;\r
 if(results.some(r=>r.status==='rejected'&&r.reason?.status===403)){invalidateAuth(true);await authBootstrap();return;}\r
 results.forEach((result,i)=>{const key=keys[i];if(result.status!=='fulfilled'){s.errors[key]=result.reason?.message||'暂时无法读取';return;}delete s.errors[key];s.loaded[key]=true;const d=result.value;if(key==='runtime'){s.runtime=d.runtime;s.config=d.config;if(!s.draft)s.draft=opsClone(d.config);}else{s[key]=d.items||[];s.next[key]=d.next;if(key==='alerts')s.coverage=d.coverage;}});\r
}\r
async function opsMore(s,key){const path=key==='alerts'?'admin/payment-alerts?'+opsAlertQuery(s,true):'admin/local-tasks/'+key+'?before='+encodeURIComponent(s.next[key]);const d=await api(path);if(!opsActive(s))return;s[key]=opsMerge(s[key],d.items);s.next[key]=d.next;if(key==='alerts')s.coverage=d.coverage;}\r
function opsDraftFromForm(form,s){const f=new FormData(form),d=s.draft;d.enabled=f.has('enabled');d.ruleVersion=String(f.get('ruleVersion')||'');s.confirmSave=f.has('confirmed');for(const kind of Object.keys(opsKinds))d.tasks[kind]={enabled:f.has(kind+'_enabled'),intervalSeconds:String(f.get(kind+'_interval')??''),batchLimit:String(f.get(kind+'_limit')??'')};for(const key of Object.keys(opsThresholds))d.thresholdSeconds[key]=String(f.get('age_'+key)??'');}\r
document.addEventListener('input',event=>{if(event.target.closest('#ops-config-form')){const s=opsState();if(!s.busy&&s.draft)opsDraftFromForm(event.target.closest('form'),s);}if(event.target.closest('#ops-ack-form'))opsState().ackNote=event.target.value;},true);\r
document.addEventListener('toggle',event=>{const details=event.target;if(!details.isConnected||!details.matches?.('#local-tasks-admin details[data-ops-detail]'))return;const s=opsState();if(!opsActive(s))return;if(details.open)s.open.add(details.dataset.opsDetail);else s.open.delete(details.dataset.opsDetail);},true);\r
document.addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.target.id!=='ops-alert-filter')return;const s=opsState();if(s.busy)return;s.filter=event.target.value;s.alerts=[];s.next.alerts=null;s.loaded.alerts=false;opsRun(s,()=>opsLoad(s));},true);\r
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const b=event.target.closest('#local-tasks-admin [data-ops]');if(!b)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();const s=opsState(),action=b.dataset.ops;opsRun(s,async()=>{\r
 if(action==='refresh'){await opsLoad(s);return;}\r
 if(action==='config-current'){const d=await api('admin/local-tasks/config');if(!opsActive(s))return;s.config=d.config;s.runtime=d.runtime;s.draft=opsClone(d.config);s.confirmSave=false;s.notice='已载入服务器当前配置。';return;}\r
 if(action.endsWith('-more')&&['runs-more','workers-more','alerts-more'].includes(action)){await opsMore(s,action.slice(0,-5));return;}\r

async function pdaFetch(s,seq,more=false){const [cfg,jobs]=await Promise.all([api('admin/privacy/domains/config'),api('admin/privacy/domains/jobs'+(more&&s.next?'?before='+encodeURIComponent(s.next):''))]);if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq))return;s.config=cfg.config;s.jobs=more?s.jobs.concat(jobs.items.filter(x=>!s.jobs.some(old=>old.id===x.id))):jobs.items;s.next=jobs.next;if(s.selected){const data=await api('admin/privacy/domains/jobs/'+encodeURIComponent(s.selected));if(pdaCurrent(s,seq))s.detail=data;}}\r
async function pdaRun(work){const s=pdaState();if(!pdaCurrent(s)||s.busy)return;const seq=++s.seq;s.busy=true;s.error='';s.notice='';pdaRender(s);try{await work(s,seq);}catch(error){if(pdaCurrent(s,seq)&&!error.handled)s.error=error.message;}finally{if(pdaCurrent(s,seq)){s.busy=false;pdaRender(s);}}}\r
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const button=event.target.closest('#privacy-domains-admin [data-pda]');if(!button)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();if(!pdaNodeCurrent(button))return;pdaRun(async(s,seq)=>{const action=button.dataset.pda;if(action==='detail'){const data=await api('admin/privacy/domains/jobs/'+encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id));if(pdaCurrent(s,seq)){s.selected=data.job.id;s.detail=data;}return;}if(['objects-more','receipts-more'].includes(action)){const field=action==='objects-more'?'objects':'receipts',cursor=s.detail?.[field+'Next'];if(!cursor)return;const data=await api('admin/privacy/domains/jobs/'+encodeURIComponent(s.selected)+'?'+(field==='objects'?'objectsBefore':'receiptsBefore')+'='+encodeURIComponent(cursor));if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq)||data.job.id!==s.selected)return;s.detail={...s.detail,job:data.job,[field]:s.detail[field].concat(data[field].filter(x=>!s.detail[field].some(old=>old.id===x.id))),[field+'Next']:data[field+'Next']};return;}if(action==='process'){const data=await api('admin/privacy/domains/objects/process',{limit:10});if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq))return;s.notice='本次已处理 '+Number(data.processed)+' 个原文件任务，具体结果见回执。';}if(action==='retry-object'){await api('admin/privacy/domains/objects/'+encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.id)+'/retry',{});if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq))return;s.notice='原文件任务已重排，尝试次数未重置。';}await pdaFetch(s,seq,action==='more');});},true);\r
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{const form=event.target;if(form.id!=='pda-config-form'&&!form.hasAttribute('data-pda-apply'))return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();if(!pdaNodeCurrent(form))return;pdaRun(async(s,seq)=>{if(form.id==='pda-config-form'){const values=new FormData(form);if(!values.has('confirmed'))return;s.configDraft=String(values.get('config'));const config=JSON.parse(s.configDraft);await api('admin/privacy/domains/config',config,'PATCH');if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq))return;s.configDraft=null;s.notice='四类资料的独立规则已保存；未部署自动清理。';}else{const job=s.detail?.job;if(!job||job.id!==form.dataset.pdaApply||job.version!==Number(form.dataset.version))return;if(!s.applyRequest||s.applyRequest.jobId!==job.id||s.applyRequest.version!==job.version)s.applyRequest={jobId:job.id,version:job.version,requestId:crypto.randomUUID()};await api('admin/privacy/domains/jobs/'+encodeURIComponent(job.id)+'/apply',{requestId:s.applyRequest.requestId,version:job.version});if(!pdaCurrent(s,seq))return;s.applyRequest=null;s.notice='原已确认批次已处理，请分别核对数据库和文件结果。';}await pdaFetch(s,seq);});},true);\r

function ciCurrent(s){return ciRuntime===s&&authCurrent(s.epoch)&&state.user?.id===s.actor&&state.user?.role==='admin';}\r
const ciKey=(s,key)=>s.requests[key]||(s.requests[key]=crypto.randomUUID());\r

const ciButton=(action,title,extra='')=>'<button type="button" class="btn secondary" data-ci="'+action+'" '+extra+'>'+esc(title)+'</button>';\r
async function ciWork(s,task){if(!ciCurrent(s)||s.busy)return;s.busy=true;s.message='';ciRender();try{await task();}catch(e){if(ciCurrent(s)&&e.code!=='AUTH_CHANGED')s.message=e.message;}finally{if(ciCurrent(s)){s.busy=false;ciRender();}}}\r
async function ciCall(s,path,body,method){try{return await api('admin/cards/'+path,body,method);}catch(e){if(ciCurrent(s)&&e.status===403){ciRuntime=null;csAdmin.draft=null;csAdmin.data=null;document.getElementById('ci-admin')?.remove();reconcileAuth();}throw e;}}\r
async function ciExport(s){\r
 const response=await fetch('/api/admin/cards/imports/'+encodeURIComponent(s.detail.job.id)+'/export',{credentials:'same-origin'});if(!ciCurrent(s))return;\r
 if(!response.ok){if(response.status===401){requireLogin();return;}if(response.status===403){ciRuntime=null;csAdmin.draft=null;csAdmin.data=null;reconcileAuth();return;}throw Error('导出失败，请回查原作业后重试。');}\r
 const reader=response.body.getReader(),decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true,ignoreBOM:true}),encoder=new TextEncoder(),parts=[],manifest=[];let pending='',header=null,complete=null,sourceSeen=false,chunk=null,lines=[],issues=0,diffs=0;\r
 const digest=async text=>Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',encoder.encode(text))),v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');\r
 const canonical=value=>value===null||typeof value!=='object'?JSON.stringify(value):Array.isArray(value)?'['+value.map(canonical).join(',')+']':'{'+Object.keys(value).sort().map(k=>JSON.stringify(k)+':'+canonical(value[k])).join(',')+'}';\r
 async function finishChunk(){if(!chunk)return;if(lines.length!==chunk.count||await digest(lines.join(''))!==chunk.sha256)throw Error('导出校验未通过，请重新回查原作业。');manifest.push({kind:chunk.kind,ordinal:chunk.ordinal,count:chunk.count,sha256:chunk.sha256});chunk=null;lines=[];}\r
 async function consume(line){if(!line)throw Error('导出格式不完整。');const row=JSON.parse(line);if(complete)throw Error('导出终态后出现额外内容。');if(row.type==='error'){ciRuntime=null;csAdmin.draft=null;csAdmin.data=null;document.getElementById('ci-admin')?.remove();reconcileAuth();throw Error('导出期间权限或资料已变化，请重新读取。');}if(!header){if(row.type!=='header'||row.schema!==1||row.job?.id!==s.detail.job.id||row.sourceSha256!==s.detail.job.sourceSha256||row.canonicalSha256!==s.detail.job.canonicalSha256)throw Error('导出缺少有效开头。');header=row;return;}\r
  if(row.type==='source'){if(sourceSeen||chunk||typeof row.rawText!=='string'||await digest(row.rawText)!==header.sourceSha256||encoder.encode(row.rawText).length!==header.rawByteCount)throw Error('原文件摘要校验未通过。');sourceSeen=true;return;}\r
  if(row.type==='chunk'){await finishChunk();if(!sourceSeen||!['issues','diff'].includes(row.kind)||!Number.isSafeInteger(row.count)||row.count<1||row.count>50||row.ordinal!==manifest.filter(x=>x.kind===row.kind).length)throw Error('导出分段不完整。');chunk=row;return;}\r
  if(row.type==='issue'||row.type==='diff'){const kind=row.type==='issue'?'issues':'diff',expected=kind==='issues'?issues:diffs;if(!chunk||chunk.kind!==kind||row.index!==expected||lines.length>=chunk.count)throw Error('导出记录顺序不完整。');lines.push(line+'\\n');if(kind==='issues')issues++;else diffs++;return;}\r
  if(row.type==='complete'){await finishChunk();if(!sourceSeen||row.complete!==true||row.issues!==issues||row.diff!==diffs||header.summary.issues!==issues||header.summary.diff!==diffs||row.chunkManifestSha256!==await digest(canonical(manifest)))throw Error('导出未完整结束，请回查后重试。');complete=row;return;}throw Error('导出包含未知记录。');\r
 }\r
 try{for(;;){if(!ciCurrent(s))return;const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;parts.push(value);pending+=decoder.decode(value,{stream:true});let pos;while((pos=pending.indexOf('\\n'))>=0){const line=pending.slice(0,pos);pending=pending.slice(pos+1);await consume(line);if(!ciCurrent(s))return;}if(pending.length>2097152)throw Error('导出单行超出约定限制。');}pending+=decoder.decode();if(pending||!complete)throw Error('导出中断，未保存不完整文件。');if(!ciCurrent(s))return;const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(parts,{type:'application/x-ndjson;charset=utf-8'})),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='card-import-'+s.detail.job.id+'.ndjson';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),0);s.message='完整来源与诊断已校验，可保存私有导出文件。';}finally{await reader.cancel().catch(()=>{});}\r
}\r

 (j?'<article class="ci-job" data-ci-job="'+esc(j.id)+'"><h3>冻结预览 · '+esc(j.status)+'</h3><h4>实际冻结目标</h4>'+ciJSON(d.target||null)+'<h4>提交来源声明（不代表审核通过）</h4>'+ciJSON(d.provenanceSummary||null)+'<p>修订 '+esc(j.version)+'；来源 SHA-256：<code>'+esc(j.sourceSha256)+'</code></p>'+ciJSON(d.summary)+'<p>问题 '+s.issues.length+' / '+esc(d.summary?.issues??'?')+'；差异 '+s.diff.length+' / '+esc(d.summary?.diff??'?')+'。分页尚未读完时可继续读取或导出完整清单。</p>'+table(['卡 / 语言 / 字段','诊断','阻止'],s.issues.map(x=>[esc(x.cardId||'卡组')+' / '+esc(x.language||'—')+'<br><code>'+esc(x.path)+'</code>',esc(x.severity)+' · '+esc(x.code)+'<p>'+esc(x.message)+'</p>',(x.blocksApply?'保存草稿 ':'')+(x.blocksPublish?'发布':'')]))+(d.issuesNext?ciButton('issues-more','更多问题'):'')+table(['卡 / 字段 / 变化','原值','新值'],s.diff.map(x=>[esc(x.cardId||'卡组')+'<br>'+esc(x.path)+' / '+esc(x.kind),ciJSON(x.before),ciJSON(x.after)]))+(d.diffNext?ciButton('diff-more','更多差异'):'')+'<div class="actions">'+ciButton('export','导出完整本人来源与诊断（私有）')+ciButton('reload','刷新原作业')+'</div>'+(j.resultVersionId?'<p>已保存草稿版本：'+esc(j.resultVersionId)+'。继续使用下方既有人工审核流程。</p>':'<label class="inline-check"><input id="ci-confirm" type="checkbox">我已核对来源、全部诊断与差异，确认仅创建待审核草稿</label>'+ciButton('apply','确认保存独立草稿'))+(d.receipt?'<h4>实际回执</h4>'+ciJSON(d.receipt):'')+'</article>':'')+\r

function cmaQuery(){const values=cmaState().filters;const query=new URLSearchParams(values).toString();return query?'?'+query:'';}\r
const cmaLoadBefore=load;\r
load=async function(nav){if(nav!=='commission')return cmaLoadBefore(nav);if(!state.user||!document.getElementById('main'))return false;const r=cmaState(),epoch=state.authEpoch,seq=++state.seq;state.nav=nav;state.editing=null;document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',b.dataset.nav===nav?'page':'false'));document.getElementById('main').innerHTML=heading('分佣沙箱')+'<p class="hint">正在读取…</p>';try{const d=await api('admin/commissions'+cmaQuery());if(!authCurrent(epoch)||state.seq!==seq||cmaRuntime!==r||state.nav!==nav)return false;r.data=d;r.error='';cmaRender();return true;}catch(e){if(authCurrent(epoch)&&state.seq===seq&&state.nav===nav&&!e.handled)document.getElementById('main').innerHTML=heading('分佣沙箱')+'<p class="error">'+esc(e.message)+'</p><button class="btn secondary" data-nav="commission">重试</button>';return false;}};\r
async function cmaWrite(path,body,method='POST'){const r=cmaState(),epoch=state.authEpoch,seq=state.seq;if(r.busy||!state.user||state.nav!=='commission')return;const active=()=>authCurrent(epoch)&&state.seq===seq&&cmaRuntime===r&&state.nav==='commission';r.busy=true;r.error='';document.querySelectorAll('[data-cma-form] button,[data-cma-action]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);try{const saved=await api('admin/commissions/'+path,body,method);if(!active())return;if(saved.rule)r.editing=saved.rule;r.busy=false;const fresh=await api('admin/commissions'+cmaQuery());if(!active())return;r.data=fresh;r.error='';cmaRender();toast('沙箱记录已保存，未发生真实转账。');}catch(e){if(active()&&!e.handled){r.error=e.message;r.busy=false;const out=document.querySelector('#main .error[role=alert]');if(out)out.textContent=e.message;}}finally{if(authCurrent(epoch)&&cmaRuntime===r){r.busy=false;if(active())document.querySelectorAll('[data-cma-form] button,[data-cma-action]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=false);}}}\r
document.addEventListener('click',async event=>{const b=event.target.closest('[data-cma-action]');if(!b)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();const r=cmaState();if(!state.user||r.busy||Number(b.dataset.cmaEpoch)!==state.authEpoch||state.nav!=='commission')return;const action=b.dataset.cmaAction;if(action==='clear-filters'){r.filters={};r.filterValues={};load('commission');return;}if(action==='edit-rule'){r.editing=r.data.rules.find(v=>v.ruleId===b.dataset.id&&v.version===Number(b.dataset.version));cmaRender();return;}if(action==='new-rule'){r.editing=null;cmaRender();return;}if(action==='export'){const epoch=state.authEpoch,seq=state.seq;try{const d=await api('admin/commissions/export'+cmaQuery());if(!authCurrent(epoch)||state.seq!==seq||state.nav!=='commission')return;const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\\uFEFF'+d.csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'})),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='sandbox-commission-ledger.csv';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}catch(e){if(authCurrent(epoch)&&state.seq===seq){r.error=e.message;cmaRender();}}return;}if(action==='advance')return cmaWrite('advance',{});if(action==='confirm')return cmaWrite('confirm',{ledgerId:b.dataset.id});if(action==='revoke-invite')return cmaWrite('invites',{code:b.dataset.id,status:'revoked'});if(['approve','book','cancel'].includes(action))return cmaWrite('statements/'+encodeURIComponent(b.dataset.id)+'/'+action,{expectedVersion:Number(b.dataset.version)});},true);\r
document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{const form=event.target;if(!form.hasAttribute('data-cma-form'))return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();if(Number(form.dataset.cmaEpoch)!==state.authEpoch||state.nav!=='commission'||cmaState().busy)return;const kind=form.dataset.cmaForm,v=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)),num=k=>Number(v[k]),check=k=>v[k]==='on';\r
 if(kind==='filters'){const r=cmaState();r.filterValues=v;r.filters=Object.fromEntries(['beneficiary','productId','contentId','kind','currency'].filter(k=>String(v[k]||'').trim()).map(k=>[k,k==='currency'?String(v[k]).trim().toUpperCase():String(v[k]).trim()]));if(v.from)r.filters.from=String(Date.parse(v.from+'T00:00:00.000Z'));if(v.to)r.filters.to=String(Date.parse(v.to+'T23:59:59.999Z'));load('commission');return;}\r
 if(kind==='settings')return cmaWrite('settings',{sandboxEnabled:check('sandboxEnabled'),stackingPolicy:v.stackingPolicy,attributionStrategy:v.attributionStrategy,productionEnabled:false,actualPaymentsEnabled:false},'PATCH');\r
 if(kind==='grant')return cmaWrite('grants',{userId:v.userId,permission:v.permission});\r
 if(kind==='rule')return cmaWrite('rules',{...(String(v.ruleId||'').trim()?{ruleId:v.ruleId}:{}),expectedVersion:num('expectedVersion'),productId:v.productId,kind:v.kind,beneficiary:v.beneficiary,currency:v.currency,mode:v.mode,rateBps:num('rateBps'),fixedMinor:num('fixedMinor'),rounding:v.rounding,capMinor:v.capMinor===''?null:num('capMinor'),freezeDays:num('freezeDays'),minimumSettlementMinor:num('minimumSettlementMinor'),status:v.status,note:v.note,basis:Object.fromEntries(['deductTax','deductShipping','deductDiscount','deductChannelFee'].map(k=>[k,check(k)]))});\r
 if(kind==='invite')return cmaWrite('invites',{code:v.code,beneficiary:v.beneficiary,priority:num('priority'),validUntil:Date.now()+num('days')*86400000});\r
 if(kind==='facts')return cmaWrite('facts',{itemId:v.itemId,channelFeeMinor:v.channelFeeMinor===''?null:num('channelFeeMinor'),discountMinor:0,source:v.source,isTestData:check('isTestData')});\r
 if(kind==='sync')return cmaWrite('orders/'+encodeURIComponent(v.orderId)+'/sync',{});\r
 if(kind==='statement')return cmaWrite('statements',{beneficiary:v.beneficiary,currency:v.currency,from:Date.parse(v.from+'T00:00:00.000Z'),to:Math.min(Date.now(),Date.parse(v.to+'T23:59:59.999Z'))});\r
 if(kind==='payment')return cmaWrite('statements/'+encodeURIComponent(v.statementId)+'/payment',{requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),isTestData:check('isTestData'),recipient:Object.fromEntries(['name','country','currency','channel','accountReference'].map(k=>[k,v[k]])),proofReference:v.proofReference});\r
},true);\r

 async function loadHere(){\r
  const r=get();if(!state.user)return false;if(r.busy){draw();return false;}const seq=++state.seq;r.loading=true;r.error='';\r
  try{const jobs=[api('admin/after-sales?environment=sandbox')];if(r.caseId)jobs.push(api('admin/after-sales/cases/'+encodeURIComponent(r.caseId)));const result=await Promise.all(jobs);if(!active(r,seq))return false;r.data=result[0];r.detail=r.caseId?result[1]:null;return true;}\r
  catch(e){if(active(r,seq)){r.error=e.message;if(e.status===401||e.status===403){r.data=null;r.detail=null;r.retry=null;}}return false;}\r
  finally{if(active(r,seq)){r.loading=false;draw();}}\r

 function requestKey(r,path,payload){const k=JSON.stringify([path,payload]);return r.keys[k]||(r.keys[k]=crypto.randomUUID());}\r
 async function mutate(path,payload,method='POST'){\r
  const r=get();if(r.busy)return;const seq=++state.seq;r.loading=false;r.busy=true;r.error='';r.mutationSeq=seq;let handled=false;\r
  const body=method==='POST'?{...payload,requestId:payload.requestId||requestKey(r,path,payload)}:payload;r.retry={path,body,method};draw();\r
  try{await api(path,body,method);if(!active(r,seq))return;handled=true;r.busy=false;r.retry=null;await loadHere();}\r
  catch(e){if(active(r,seq)){handled=true;r.busy=false;r.error=e.message;if(e.status===401||e.status===403){r.data=null;r.detail=null;r.retry=null;}draw();}}\r
  finally{if(runtime===r&&authCurrent(r.epoch)&&r.mutationSeq===seq){r.busy=false;if(!handled&&state.nav==='afterSales')void loadHere();}}\r

 function install(){\r
  if(installed)return;if(typeof load!=='function'||typeof api!=='function'||typeof labels!=='object')throw Error('Load existing admin framework first');installed=true;labels.afterSales='售后受理与退货验收';\r
   if(typeof allowedNavs==='function'){const priorAllowed=allowedNavs;allowedNavs=function(user=state.user){const items=priorAllowed(user).filter(k=>k!=='afterSales');if(user?.role==='admin')items.push('afterSales');return items;};}\r
  const previousLoad=load;load=async function(nav){if(nav!=='afterSales')return previousLoad(nav);state.nav=nav;document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',b.dataset.nav===nav?'page':'false'));return loadHere();};\r
  document.addEventListener('click',event=>{\r
   const b=event.target.closest?.('[data-af-admin]');if(!b)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();const r=get();if(r.busy)return;\r
   if(b.dataset.afAdmin==='refresh')void loadHere();\r
   if(b.dataset.afAdmin==='open'){r.caseId=b.dataset.id;r.detail=null;r.retry=null;void loadHere();}\r
   if(b.dataset.afAdmin==='retry'&&r.retry)void mutate(r.retry.path,r.retry.body,r.retry.method);\r
  },true);\r
  document.addEventListener('submit',event=>{\r
   const form=event.target.closest?.('[data-af-admin-form]');if(!form)return;event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();const r=get();if(r.busy||state.nav!=='afterSales'||!form.reportValidity())return;const f=new FormData(form),kind=form.dataset.afAdminForm;\r
   if(kind==='settings'){void mutate('admin/after-sales/settings',{sandboxEnabled:f.get('sandboxEnabled')==='on',productionEnabled:false,ruleVersion:String(f.get('ruleVersion')||'').trim()||null},'PATCH');return;}\r
   const c=r.detail;if(!c||c.id!==form.dataset.case)return;\r
   if(kind==='decision')void mutate('admin/after-sales/cases/'+encodeURIComponent(c.id)+'/decision',{version:c.version,decision:String(f.get('decision')),reason:String(f.get('reason'))});\r
   if(kind==='inspect'){\r
    const items=[];\r
    for(const x of c.items){\r
     const receivedQuantity=Number(f.get('received:'+x.id)||0),restockQuantity=Number(f.get('restock:'+x.id)||0);\r
     if(!receivedQuantity&&!restockQuantity)continue;\r
     const condition=String(f.get('condition:'+x.id)||'').trim();\r
     if(!Number.isSafeInteger(receivedQuantity)||receivedQuantity<1||!Number.isSafeInteger(restockQuantity)||restockQuantity<0||restockQuantity>receivedQuantity||!condition){r.error='请逐项填写实际实收、明确入库数量及状态依据；不可自动全入库。';draw();return;}\r
     items.push({caseItemId:x.id,receivedQuantity,restockQuantity,condition});\r
    }\r
    if(!items.length){r.error='请至少填写一项本次实际收到的数量。';draw();return;}\r
    void mutate('admin/after-sales/cases/'+encodeURIComponent(c.id)+'/inspect',{version:c.version,receiptReference:String(f.get('receiptReference')),items,note:String(f.get('note'))});\r
   }\r
  },true);\r
 }\r

// Exact decimal input in the original currency's major unit. No floating-point parsing.\r
(function(root){\r
 'use strict';\r
 const codes='CNY USD EUR GBP HKD TWD JPY KRW CAD AUD NZD SGD CHF THB MYR IDR VND PHP INR AED SAR BRL MXN ZAR BHD KWD OMR JOD TND'.split(' ');\r
 function exponent(currency){if(!codes.includes(currency))throw Error('Unsupported original currency');return ['JPY','KRW','IDR','VND'].includes(currency)?0:['KWD','BHD','OMR','JOD','TND'].includes(currency)?3:2;}\r
 function parse(value,currency,nullable=false){\r
  if(typeof value!=='string')throw Error('Amount must be explicit decimal text');\r
  const raw=value.trim(),d=exponent(currency);if(!raw&&nullable)return null;\r
  if(!new RegExp('^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\\\.([0-9]{1,'+Math.max(d,1)+'}))?$').test(raw)||(!d&&raw.includes('.')))throw Error('Invalid currency amount');\r
  const [whole,fraction='']=raw.split('.');if(fraction.length>d)throw Error('Too many decimal places');\r
  const minor=BigInt(whole)*10n**BigInt(d)+BigInt((fraction+'0'.repeat(d)).slice(0,d)||'0');\r
  if(minor>1000000000n)throw Error('Amount exceeds supported range');return Number(minor);\r
 }\r
 function decimal(minor,currency){const d=exponent(currency);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(minor)||minor<0)throw Error('Invalid minor amount');const raw=String(minor).padStart(d+1,'0');return d?raw.slice(0,-d)+'.'+raw.slice(-d):raw;}\r
 function format(minor,currency){return minor===null||minor===undefined?'—':currency+' '+decimal(minor,currency);}\r
 root.AfterSalesFinanceMoney=Object.freeze({exponent,parse,decimal,format,currencies:Object.freeze(codes)});\r
})(typeof globalThis==='object'?globalThis:this);\r

async function bzsAdminWork(s,task){if(!bzsAdminCurrent(s)||s.busy)return;s.busy=true;s.message='';bzsAdminRender(s);try{await task();}catch(e){if(bzsAdminCurrent(s)&&e.status===403){bzsAdminRuntime=null;reconcileAuth();}else if(bzsAdminCurrent(s)&&e.code!=='AUTH_CHANGED')s.message=e.message;}finally{if(bzsAdminCurrent(s)){s.busy=false;bzsAdminRender(s);}}}\r
async function bzsAdminImport(s,file){\r

function todos(){const wait=state.works.filter(w=>['ai_review','manual_review'].includes(w.status)).length,returned=state.works.filter(w=>w.status==='rejected').length,drafts=state.works.filter(w=>w.status==='draft').length,pending=state.consultations.filter(c=>c.status==='pending').length;return '<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>待办事项</h2></div>'+[[drafts,'未完成草稿','draft'],[wait,'审核中','reviewing'],[returned,'未通过作品','rejected']].map(([n,h,filter])=>'<button class="todo" data-open-filter="'+filter+'"><span>'+h+'</span><span class="row"><b>'+n+'</b>'+icon('right')+'</span></button>').join('')+'<button class="todo" data-tab="consultations"><span>待处理咨询</span><span class="row"><b>'+pending+'</b>'+icon('right')+'</span></button></section>'}\r
function quickTools(){return '<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>创作工作台</h2><button class="link" data-help="publish">发布说明 '+icon('right')+'</button></div><div class="quick-grid">'+[['video','video','视频创作','把经验记录成影像'],['article','image','图文表达','让观点与知识更清晰'],['course','book','课程创作','组织有体系的学习内容']].map(([t,i,h,p])=>'<button class="quick-card" data-publish="'+t+'"><span class="quick-art">'+icon(i)+'</span><span class="quick-copy"><b>'+h+'</b><small>'+p+'</small></span></button>').join('')+'</div></section>'}\r
function reviewRail(){const updated=state.works.filter(w=>w.status!=='draft').slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.updatedAt)-new Date(a.updatedAt)).slice(0,3);return '<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>审核动态</h2><button class="link" data-tab="works">全部 '+icon('right')+'</button></div>'+(updated.length?'<div class="rail-list">'+updated.map(w=>'<button class="rail-item" data-reviews="'+esc(w.id)+'" style="border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;text-align:left;width:100%"><span class="rail-dot"></span><span style="min-width:0"><b>'+esc(w.title)+'</b><p>'+esc(statusNames[w.status]||w.status)+'</p></span><span class="date">'+esc(shortDate(w.updatedAt).slice(5))+'</span></button>').join('')+'</div>':'<div class="rail-empty">'+icon('shield')+'<span>提交作品后，审核状态<br>会及时显示在这里。</span></div>')+'</section>'}\r
function interactionPanel(){const waiting=state.consultations.filter(c=>c.status==='pending'),latest=state.consultations[0];return '<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>互动与咨询</h2><button class="link" data-tab="consultations">进入管理 '+icon('right')+'</button></div><div class="interaction-grid"><div class="interaction-item"><div class="interaction-head"><b>'+icon('chat')+'收到的APP咨询</b><span class="badge">'+waiting.length+' 待处理</span></div><p class="interaction-copy">'+(latest?esc(latest.name||'学员')+'：'+esc(String(latest.body||'').slice(0,62)):'APP用户向你的认证老师展示页提交咨询后，可在这里查看并受理。')+'</p></div><div class="interaction-item"><div class="interaction-head"><b>'+icon('heart')+'内容互动</b><button class="link" data-tab="analytics">查看数据 '+icon('right')+'</button></div><p class="interaction-copy">近'+state.days+'天，APP作品收到 <b>'+num(state.analytics?.totals?.likes)+'</b> 次点赞、<b>'+num(state.analytics?.totals?.favorites)+'</b> 次收藏。查看作品表现，了解哪些内容带来了连接。</p></div></div></section>'}\r
function overview(){return accountStrip()+'<div class="home-grid"><div class="home-main">'+quickTools()+homeData()+recentPanel()+interactionPanel()+'</div><aside class="home-rail">'+reviewRail()+todos()+'<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>APP展示位置</h2></div><div class="rail-list"><div class="rail-item">'+icon('video')+'<span><b>视频作品</b><p>社群推荐视频与APP作者主页</p></span></div><div class="rail-item">'+icon('book')+'<span><b>课程内容</b><p>智慧馆与APP作者主页</p></span></div><div class="rail-item">'+icon('file')+'<span><b>图文作品</b><p>APP作者主页中的作品</p></span></div><a class="link" href="/experience?page=creatorProfile&creator='+encodeURIComponent(state.me.user.id)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">查看APP作者展示页 '+icon('external')+'</a></div></section></aside></div><p class="page-note">'+icon('shield')+'仅管理本人在东方智慧 APP 内的作品、账号数据与咨询 · 数据采集开始：'+esc(shortDate(state.analytics?.startedAt))+' · 未采集历史不补算</p>'}\r
function filteredWorks(){let list=state.works.filter(w=>(state.filter==='all'||w.status===state.filter||state.filter==='reviewing'&&['ai_review','manual_review'].includes(w.status))&&(state.workType==='all'||w.type===state.workType)&&(!state.query||w.title.toLowerCase().includes(state.query.toLowerCase())));if(state.workDate!=='all'){const since=Date.now()-Number(state.workDate)*86400000;list=list.filter(w=>new Date(w.createdAt).getTime()>=since)}list=list.slice().sort((a,b)=>state.workSort==='oldest'?new Date(a.createdAt)-new Date(b.createdAt):state.workSort==='plays'?(workStats(b.id).plays||0)-(workStats(a.id).plays||0):new Date(b.createdAt)-new Date(a.createdAt));return list}\r
function duration(v){const n=Math.max(0,Math.round(Number(v)||0));return Math.floor(n/60)+':'+String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}\r
function thumbnail(w){return '<div class="work-cover">'+(safeUrl(w.coverUrl)?'<img alt="" src="'+esc(safeUrl(w.coverUrl))+'" loading="lazy">':icon(w.type==='video'?'video':w.type==='course'?'book':'file'))+'<span class="work-cover-tag"><span>'+esc(types[w.type]||'作品')+'</span><span>'+((w.duration||0)>0?duration(w.duration):'')+'</span></span></div>'}\r
function workActions(w){return '<div class="work-actions">'+(w.status==='published'?'<a class="work-app-link" href="/experience?page=creatorProfile&creator='+encodeURIComponent(state.me.user.id)+'&work='+encodeURIComponent(w.id)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">APP查看</a>':'')+'<button data-edit="'+esc(w.id)+'">'+icon('edit')+'编辑作品</button><button data-reviews="'+esc(w.id)+'">'+icon('clock')+'审核记录</button>'+(w.status==='draft'?'<button data-submit="'+esc(w.id)+'">提交审核</button>':'')+(w.status==='rejected'?'<button data-appeal="'+esc(w.id)+'">申请复核</button>':'')+(['published','ai_review','manual_review'].includes(w.status)?'<button class="danger" data-withdraw="'+esc(w.id)+'">撤回作品</button>':'')+'</div>'}\r
function workCard(w){const s=workStats(w.id),media=w.type==='video'||['audio','video'].includes(w.format)&&!!w.mediaUrl,rate=s.plays?Math.min(100,(s.completions||0)/s.plays*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'—',metrics=[['曝光',s.impressions],['浏览',s.views],...(media?[['播放',s.plays]]:[]),['点赞',s.likes],['收藏',s.favorites],['分享记录',s.shares],...(media?[['观看 / 分钟',Math.round((s.watchSeconds||0)/60*10)/10],['完播率',rate]]:[]),...(w.type==='course'?[['学习人数',s.learners]]:[])];return '<article class="work-card" data-work-card="'+esc(w.id)+'">'+thumbnail(w)+'<div class="work-info"><div class="work-top"><div style="min-width:0"><h3 class="work-title">'+esc(w.title)+'</h3><div class="work-date">'+esc(when(w.createdAt))+'　'+labelStatus(w.status)+'</div></div>'+workActions(w)+'</div>'+(w.reason?'<p class="work-reason">'+esc(w.reason)+'</p>':'')+'<div class="work-kpis" data-work-type="'+esc(w.type)+'">'+metrics.map(([label,v])=>'<div class="work-kpi"><span>'+label+'</span><b>'+(typeof v==='string'?v:num(v))+'</b></div>').join('')+'</div></div></article>'}\r
function workTable(items,analytics=false){if(!items.length)return empty('还没有作品','保存草稿后，准备好再提交审核。','<button class="btn small" data-do="new">新建作品</button>');if(!analytics)return '<div class="content-list">'+items.map(workCard).join('')+'</div>';items=items.map(w=>({...state.works.find(x=>x.id===w.id),...w}));const type=state.analyticsType,columns=[['impressions','曝光'],['views','浏览'],['likes','点赞'],['favorites','收藏'],['shares','分享记录']];if(type==='video')columns.splice(2,0,['plays','播放'],['watchSeconds','观看 / 分钟'],['completionRate','完播率']);if(type==='course')columns.splice(2,0,['learners','学习人数'],['plays','播放'],['watchSeconds','观看 / 分钟']);return '<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>作品</th><th>类型</th>'+columns.map(c=>'<th>'+c[1]+'</th>').join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+items.map(w=>'<tr><td>'+esc(w.title)+'</td><td>'+esc(types[w.type]||w.type)+'</td>'+columns.map(([key])=>'<td>'+(key==='completionRate'?(w.plays?Math.min(100,(w.completions||0)/w.plays*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'—'):['plays','watchSeconds'].includes(key)&&!(w.type==='video'||w.format==='audio'||w.format==='video')?'—':num(key==='watchSeconds'?Math.round((w[key]||0)/60*10)/10:w[key]))+'</td>').join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>'}\r
function recentPanel(){return '<section class="panel recent-panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>近期作品</h2><button class="link" data-tab="works">全部作品 '+icon('right')+'</button></div>'+workTable(state.works.slice(0,3))+'</section>'}\r
function works(){const list=filteredWorks();return head('内容管理','管理本人作品、审核进度与APP内的实际表现。','<button class="btn" data-do="new">'+icon('plus')+'发布作品</button>')+'<div class="section-tabs">'+[['all','全部作品'],['video','视频'],['article','图文'],['course','课程']].map(([t,n])=>'<button data-work-type="'+t+'" aria-pressed="'+(state.workType===t)+'">'+n+' <small>('+state.works.filter(w=>t==='all'||w.type===t).length+')</small></button>').join('')+'</div><div class="filterbar"><div class="filters"><select class="control" id="work-status" aria-label="审核状态">'+[['all','全部状态'],['draft','草稿'],['reviewing','审核中'],['published','已发布'],['rejected','未通过']].map(([s,n])=>'<option value="'+s+'" '+(state.filter===s?'selected':'')+'>'+n+'</option>').join('')+'</select><select class="control" id="work-date" aria-label="创建日期">'+[['all','全部日期'],['7','近7天'],['30','近30天'],['90','近90天']].map(([s,n])=>'<option value="'+s+'" '+(state.workDate===s?'selected':'')+'>'+n+'</option>').join('')+'</select><select class="control" id="work-sort" aria-label="作品排序">'+[['latest','最新创建'],['oldest','最早创建'],['plays','播放量最高']].map(([s,n])=>'<option value="'+s+'" '+(state.workSort===s?'selected':'')+'>'+n+'</option>').join('')+'</select></div><div class="row" style="flex-wrap:nowrap;min-width:0"><label class="search-wrap">'+icon('search')+'<input class="search" id="search" type="search" placeholder="搜索作品" aria-label="搜索作品标题" value="'+esc(state.query)+'"></label><button class="btn secondary small" data-export="works">'+icon('download')+'导出数据</button></div></div><div id="work-results">'+(list.length?workTable(list):empty(state.works.length?'没有匹配的作品':'还没有作品',state.works.length?'尝试调整体裁、日期或审核状态。':'先保存一份草稿，让你的分享从这里开始。','<button class="btn small" data-do="new">新建作品</button>'))+'</div><div class="list-foot"><span>共 '+list.length+' 份作品 · 数据周期：近'+state.days+'天</span><span>已发布作品修改后将重新审核</span></div>'}\r
function analytics(){const v=state.analytics?.totals||{},key=state.chartMetric,d=metricDefs[key],rows=(state.analytics?.works||[]).filter(w=>state.analyticsType==='all'||w.type===state.analyticsType).slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.plays||0)-(a.plays||0));const rate=v.plays?Math.min(100,(v.completions||0)/v.plays*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'—',avg=v.plays?num((v.watchSeconds||0)/v.plays):'—';return head('数据中心','APP账号数据 · 统计周期：'+rangeText()+' · 北京时间', '<div class="row">'+dateRange()+'<button class="btn secondary small" data-export="analytics">'+icon('download')+'导出数据</button></div>')+'<section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>数据总览</h2><button class="link" data-help="data">数据指标说明 '+icon('help')+'</button></div><div class="analytics-metrics">'+['plays','views','impressions','likes','favorites','followers'].map(k=>metricTile(k,true)).join('')+'</div><div class="analytics-overview"><div>'+chart(true)+'<div class="metric-grid">'+['watchSeconds','completions','learners','profileViews','shares','consultations'].map(k=>metricTile(k)).join('')+'</div></div><aside class="metric-analysis"><h3>'+d[0]+'分析</h3><div class="big-value">'+num(totalFor(key))+' <span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:400">'+d[1]+'</span></div><p>'+d[2]+'<br>'+(totalFor(key)?'你可以结合下方作品表现，回看哪些内容获得了更多连接。':'这个周期还没有记录到该项活动。发布作品后，可以在这里持续观察变化。')+'</p><small>数据来自 APP 内真实活动</small></aside></div><div class="data-summary-row"><div class="summary-stat"><span>平均观看时长</span><b>'+avg+'</b><small>秒 / 次播放</small></div><div class="summary-stat"><span>完整观看率</span><b>'+rate+'</b></div><div class="summary-stat"><span>APP当前关注人数</span><b>'+num(v.followers)+'</b><small>人</small></div><div class="summary-stat"><span>收到咨询</span><b>'+num(v.consultations)+'</b><small>条</small></div></div></section><section class="panel"><div class="panel-title"><h2>作品数据<span class="caption">近'+state.days+'天 · 按播放量排序</span></h2><div class="row"><select class="control" id="analytics-type" aria-label="数据作品类型">'+[['all','全部类型'],...Object.entries(types)].map(([t,n])=>'<option value="'+t+'" '+(state.analyticsType===t?'selected':'')+'>'+n+'</option>').join('')+'</select><button class="link" data-tab="works">内容管理 '+icon('right')+'</button></div></div>'+workTable(rows,true)+'</section><p class="page-note">'+icon('shield')+'观看时长按实际有效播放统计，拖动进度不计入。未登录访客按浏览器识别，不能代替跨设备唯一人数。</p>'}\r
function profileForm(apply=false){const p=state.me.profile||{},u=state.me.user;return '<form id="profile-form" data-apply="'+apply+'"><div class="formgrid"><label class="field">APP展示名称<input name="displayName" maxlength="80" required value="'+esc(p.displayName||u.name)+'"><small>用于APP公开作者展示页，供APP用户识别作者。</small></label><label class="field">APP公开头像<span class="dropzone" style="min-height:75px;padding:12px">'+icon('image')+'<span><b>上传头像</b><small>JPG / PNG</small></span><input type="file" data-upload="avatarUrl" accept="image/png,image/jpeg" aria-label="上传头像"></span><input class="upload-url" name="avatarUrl" readonly placeholder="上传后自动保存" value="'+esc(p.avatarUrl||'')+'"><div class="upload-progress"><i></i></div><div class="upload-status"></div></label><label class="field full">APP作者简介<textarea name="bio" maxlength="2000" rows="5" required placeholder="填写用于APP公开作者展示页的经历、创作方向与擅长领域。">'+esc(p.bio||'')+'</textarea><small>此简介用于APP公开资料，不显示在本工作台首页。</small></label></div><div class="form-actions"><button class="btn" type="submit">'+(apply?'提交入驻申请':'保存资料')+'</button></div><p class="statusline error" role="alert"></p></form>'}\r

async function load(){const epoch=creatorIdentityEpoch,revision=++creatorReadRevision;try{const me=await api('/api/creator/me');if(epoch!==creatorIdentityEpoch||revision!==creatorReadRevision)return false;let payload={me,works:[],analytics:null,consultations:[],categories:[]};if(me.user&&me.eligible&&!['operator','reviewer'].includes(me.user.role)){const [w,a,c,p]=await Promise.all([api('/api/creator/works'),api('/api/creator/analytics?days='+state.days),api('/api/creator/consultations'),api('/api/public')]);payload={me,works:w.items||[],analytics:a,consultations:c.items||[],categories:(p.content?.courseCategories||[]).filter(x=>x.enabled!==false)}}if(epoch!==creatorIdentityEpoch||revision!==creatorReadRevision)return false;Object.assign(state,payload);render();return true}catch(error){if(epoch!==creatorIdentityEpoch||revision!==creatorReadRevision||error.code==='IDENTITY_CHANGED')return false;throw error}}\r
async function refreshWorks(){const epoch=creatorIdentityEpoch,[w,a]=await Promise.all([api('/api/creator/works'),api('/api/creator/analytics?days='+state.days)]);if(epoch!==creatorIdentityEpoch)return false;state.works=w.items||[];state.analytics=a;return true}\r
async function busy(button,fn){if(button?.disabled)return;const epoch=creatorIdentityEpoch;button&&(button.disabled=true);try{await fn()}catch(e){if(epoch!==creatorIdentityEpoch||e.code==='IDENTITY_CHANGED')return;toast(e.message);const err=$('#content .statusline')||$('#login-form .statusline');if(err)err.textContent=e.message}finally{if(button?.isConnected)button.disabled=false}}\r
const formTasks=new WeakMap();\r
function formTask(form){let task=formTasks.get(form);if(!task){task={saving:false,uploads:0};formTasks.set(form,task)}return task}\r
function syncFormTask(form){const task=formTask(form),locked=task.saving||task.uploads>0;form.querySelectorAll('button[type="submit"],button:not([type]),input[data-upload]').forEach(el=>el.disabled=locked);form.setAttribute('aria-busy',String(locked))}\r
async function formBusy(form,fn){const task=formTask(form);if(task.saving||task.uploads){if(task.uploads)toast('素材正在上传，请完成后再保存。');return}task.saving=true;syncFormTask(form);try{await busy(null,fn)}finally{task.saving=false;syncFormTask(form)}}\r
function rememberWork(item){if(!item?.id||!Number.isInteger(item.version))throw Error('作品保存响应异常，请刷新作品列表确认结果。');state.works=[item,...state.works.filter(w=>w.id!==item.id)];if(state.tab==='edit')state.editing=item;return item}\r

function mediaDuration(file){return new Promise(resolve=>{const media=document.createElement(file.type.startsWith('audio')?'audio':'video'),local=URL.createObjectURL(file);let done=false;const finish=value=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(timer);media.removeAttribute('src');media.load();URL.revokeObjectURL(local);resolve(value)},timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(null),5000);media.preload='metadata';media.onloadedmetadata=()=>finish(Number.isFinite(media.duration)&&media.duration>0?Math.round(media.duration):null);media.onerror=()=>finish(null);media.src=local})}\r
